correctness.rationale: Euler-characteristic additivity gives the exact categories; correction stalks of arbitrary prescribed Euler characteristic preserve the required support conditions and prove the object-ideal identities and uniform special ideal approximations. The standard Ext formula gives the ideal cotorsion equalities, and long exact cohomology gives the sharp truncated-Euler-characteristic criteria.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The inspected 2026 source treats only the parity/even case B=2Z, and targeted searches did not locate the subgroup-parametrized theorem, the exact criteria for all B, or the completeness iff B=Z dichotomy. General ideal approximation theory is prior art; implicit K0-theoretic coverage remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result turns a single parity counterexample into a sharp classification for every subgroup of the Euler-characteristic group, including the infinite-index zero subgroup, and identifies precisely when ideal completeness fails to descend to object completeness.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
